units.name: 问路与指路
units.description:
用 Where is ...? / How can I get to ...? / Is there ... near here? 询问地点，用 Go straight、turn left/right、next to、between ... and ... 等说明路线；问路先以 Excuse me 开场，得到帮助后道谢，没听清时可说 Pardon? 或 Thank you all the same.
【教材】人教版PEP英语六年级上册 Unit 1 How can I get there?
【课标】义教英语课标2022 二级 语用：问路与指路
units.curriculum_standard: 义教英语课标2022·二级·语用：问路与指路

rich_content.definition: 问路与指路是小学阶段的核心交际功能：用特殊疑问句和 There be 句型询问地点，用方位介词与行走指令说明路线，并根据对方身份和场合选择礼貌表达。
key_points: ⚠️ 问路先礼貌开场：Excuse me.；结束用 Thank you. / Thank you all the same.
⚠️ 指路按行走顺序说：Go straight (for ...), turn left/right at the ..., then it's on your left/right.
⚠️ 方位表达用 next to / between ... and ... / across from / behind / in front of；left/right 以问路者行进方向为准。
examples: —Excuse me, where is the museum? —Go straight and turn right at the second crossing. It's next to the library.
—How can I get to the post office? —Walk along this street. It's between the bank and the supermarket.
—Is there a hospital near here? —Yes. It's across from the park.
rich_content.intuition: 把路线想成一条有方向的路：先定起点，再按“直走—转弯—参照物”的顺序说，听的人就能一步步走到。
rich_content.connections: 向前衔接特殊疑问句、There be 句型和方位介词；向后衔接出行方式、地图与游记类语篇。
common_mistakes: 把 left/right 按说话人自己的方向说，而不是按问路者前进方向。
漏掉冠词或介词：说成 go straight the street / next the bank。
只给地名不给路线，或把路线顺序说反。
rich_content.counter_examples: “Where is the museum?” 回答 “It's a museum.” 没有提供位置信息；正确应给出方向或参照物，如 “It's next to the library.”
